notes.title: We have carried out an update to improve usability.
notes.content: [p]We have carried out an update to improve usability.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773210/d92642e18c464486b19145456ed0f87e1b30796f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You can see which blocks can be broken depending on the number of jellies you've collected.[/p]

notes.title: My Room Update
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773210/13a57e3f6de964b9b782b44d196e604dd97809a0.png"][/img][/p][p]My Room is getting new content![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773210/2cf7f9a0d3adff7da741d69dc4081e2fa0246ae7.png"][/img][/p][p]My Room lets you view your best clear time, how many times you've cleared the stage, and your score.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773210/544ccdfa105955b3fbd6ca4349770ba5280fedd9.png"][/img][/p][p]Each time you clear a stage, a new jelly will be added to My Room.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773210/305d2a9b74d92eca9d0ca8899228e2abc8a29a9b.png"][/img][/p][p]These jellies are also visible during gameplay.[/p]

notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.content:
Minor bug fix

Fixed the issue where gravity value became 0 during continuous input in dive mode

notes.title: The new season, 'Love Dive,' is now starting!
notes.content:
The new season, 'Love Dive,' is now starting!

- New map 'Dive' added.
- Support for new languages, including Korean, Japanese, Russian, and Chinese.
- A new difficulty level has been added.
- The ranking system will be discontinued. No new rankings can be registered, and existing ranked users will be honored in the Hall of Fame.

notes.title: New Season Update Notice
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773210/a4e8ccea4ce10c8ceacbd504b6c8b58bfce6e012.png"][/img][/p][p]A new season update for Flying Pudding is scheduled to be released.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40773210/89ed42c5cdb6ad540443c65e40cb8fd36ebfbefe.gif"][/img][/p][p]A new map called “Dive” will be added.[/p][p]A new difficulty level is also planned.[/p][p][/p][p]The existing design has been updated.[/p][p]The ranking system will be discontinued, and it will no longer be possible to register new rankings.[/p][p]Players currently listed in the rankings will be recorded in the Hall of Fame.[/p][p][/p][p]Score saving and related features will be added in the future.[/p][p][/p]
